sources.title: Load Connection Capacity Assessment of South African National Ports
limitations: Substation spare-capacity estimates are not reserved capacity or a utility connection offer.
Upstream network consultation and detailed connection studies may be required.

sources.title: Shore Power Demand for South African Ports
limitations: The study analyses vessel activity and estimated shore-power demand over 2018-2025.
A demand ranking is not a berth-level equipment inventory or a current metered load profile.

sources.title: TNPA Media Statement: renewable energy and solar-powered seawater desalination RFPs in Nelson Mandela Bay

sources.title: Proposed Coega Green Hydrogen and Ammonia Project — environmental authorization notice
limitations: Authorization does not establish FID, financing, construction, grid connection, renewable PPAs, water supply or current load.

sources.title: TNPA / Ukwanda LNG terminal agreement announcement
limitations: Long-dated planned infrastructure is not available generation or a current supply contract.

sources.title: CSIR WaveNet Port of Ngqura station information and wave data
limitations: Public page warns displayed values are estimates and should not be used to draw conclusions.

sources.title: CSIR WaveNet history — Port of Durban ADCP observation record
limitations: Current station status, configuration, depth bins, calibration, uptime, data rights and missing-data periods must be reconfirmed.

sources.title: Instantaneous Demand Response Programme
limitations: Published programme description is not an offer or approval for any port or data centre.
Confirm aggregation, baseline, metering, response testing, current programme procurement and contract terms directly.

30-minute interval metering does not qualify a six-second IDR service.

South African demand-response qualification: separate Eskom 6 s IDR, SAWEM 10 s instantaneous reserve, NTCSA supplemental DR and emergency NRS 048-9 load reduction; verify site-specific programme eligibility and metering.

paired_site_strategy.rationale: Ngqura has higher published pre-feasibility spare connection capacity; Durban has the highest estimated shore-power demand and materially lower reported spare capacity.
paired_site_strategy.non_claim: This is a paired evidence-acquisition strategy, not a site selection, utility connection offer or subsea data-centre siting decision.

product_distinctions: Eskom IDR six-second response is not the same product definition as SAWEM ten-second instantaneous reserve.
Supplemental DR with 30-minute interval metering is not proof of six-second IDR performance.
Emergency load reduction under NRS 048-9 is not a voluntary contracted DR service.
Published substation spare capacity is not metered or contracted demand-response availability.

ngqura.note: 17.1 MW is pre-feasibility spare connection estimate, not flexible load, contracted IDR or response capacity.

durban.note: 3.6 MW is pre-feasibility spare connection estimate, not flexible load or response capacity; below the published 10 MW Eskom IDR minimum as a single resource, but aggregation eligibility is unknown.

next_evidence_required: Written current Eskom/NTCSA programme eligibility and aggregation confirmation for port and data-centre participants

Qualified controllable-load inventory with minimum stable consumption, available MW, response latency, sustain duration and restoration/rebound profile
Participant agreement, event authority, notice channel, event frequency, compensation, non-delivery treatment and settlement methodology
Whether multiple port tenants or electrical points of delivery may be aggregated into one eligible resource, and exact rules for network-zone and feeder scope
Current NERSA approval and SAWEM implementation status after the 15 September 2026 tracker snapshot
